scope: Read every line of reconstructed driver, and unchanged transport Recorder/Client/Server construction, HTTP and shutdown paths. This is not execution qualification.
checks: Loopback-only HTTP and server bind; four distinct sealed ports; owned canonical0700 directories and distinct 64hex credentials.
Both exact source and prospective-merge CI must be completed/success at pinned commit/tree; package identity and transport/driver bytes are checked before run.
First server stopped before foreign-owner server; cold and crash-restored servers are owned process groups. Constructor failures and outer finally both perform bounded owned cleanup.
Three normal cases each perform one roundtrip and two identical replays; zero-forward and zero-compiler replays require unchanged artifact/journal effect inventories.
Prepare is zero-forward, zero-optimizer, zero-label and no artifact/journal effect; four intents are prebound to finite KEEP/sign choices.

Graph-only crash requires unchanged checkpoint bytes but different complete function; exact expected publication then owned SIGSTOP, absent inverse and absent Restored charge/result, then actual SIGKILL and interrupted RPC.

Cold recover after deleting admitted source paths uses original credential metadata and creates no source copy; full inverse compares original checkpoint bytes, parent function, normal route, fixed reset and evaluator.
Crash recovery prohibits parent/candidate/selection/compiler replay; parent and candidate charge/result presence and hashes remain unchanged, including originally absent files.

Cross-profile invalid-params exception is accepted only for the explicitly marked negative control and persisted HTTP200, exact raw digest, same request ID/type, JSONRPC2.0, no result and integer -32602.
Source-bound budgets reconcile: 4 servers; 10 roundtrip wire calls; 4 intents; 6 recover calls; 1 kill; <=29 complete plus partial forwards; <=8 pure compiler invocations; no training.
limitations: No native server/model/optimizer/grader or tests were executed by this reviewer.
Static review cannot certify race-window interception; missing publication window must remain failure and is not retried.
Previously observed scientific batches are engineering replay, not independent model quality evidence.
Parent/foreign-owner tool negative controls assert authenticated isError plus no model/journal effects, not a particular textual error reason.
Full/partial forward total is a source-control-flow upper bound, not an exact measured total.
Lost historical driver hash is explicitly distinct; this receipt does not recreate its earlier pre-execution timing.
